cohort: The study included 402 preterm infants (less than 37 weeks gestational age) admitted between January 2023 and May 2024.
finding: A machine learning model (AdaBoost) accurately predicts feeding intolerance in preterm infants before first feeding using 14 routinely collected clinical variables, demonstrating superior performance and greater net clinical benefit.
birth_weight: Measured as a predictive variable, but no specific range for the cohort is provided.
